invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2400（基于当前价格微调，约-0.7%），或融资费率Z-score升至>80%（极度多头拥挤），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2125.21）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2400 (slightly adjusted from current, ~-0.7%), or funding Z-score rises to >80% (extremely long crowded), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2125.21).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破0.101（阻力位），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（多头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $0.09）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 0.101 (resistance), or funding Z-score falls to <50% (long pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $0.09).
